voices.description: Creator-selected reference voice anchored to three supplied MP4 reference clips. Intended for primary narration or lead storytelling roles where natural rhythm and pronunciation continuity are required.
voices.accent_and_pronunciation_profile: American English pronunciation observed across all three supplied clips; exact regional dialect not forensically assessed.
voices.pitch_and_vocal_texture_profile: Young-adult male vocal register with crisp, energetic projection observed in reference clips; numerical pitch (Hz) not assessed.
voices.speaking_pace: Brisk, high-retention Shorts cadence in supplied clips; slows slightly for suspense or emotional reveals.
voices.rhythm_and_pause_behaviour: Tight clause-to-clause transitions with minimal dead air; uses brief pre-twist pauses (e.g., ~0.4s pause observed at 0:50.3-0:50.7 in 1000015040.mp4) and emphatic punch on reveal lines.
voices.emotional_delivery_range: Wide expressive range observed in 1000015041.mp4 (conversational setup, comedic beats, urgent shouting, heartfelt reveal; LRA 3.7 LU); suspenseful urgency in 1000015040.mp4; dry/deadpan comedy in 1000015039.mp4.

primary_reference.selection_reason: Highest audio bitrate (128.0 kbps AAC, 44.1 kHz), 0 clipped samples, longest usable narrator speech (99.73s), and widest observed emotional range (LRA 3.7 LU).

supporting_references.role: Supporting suspense/horror delivery reference (58.68s, 128.1 kbps AAC, 0 clipped samples, -0.2 dBFS peak).
Supporting deadpan comedy pacing reference (33.90s, lower 48.1 kbps AAC bitrate, 7 clipped samples at +1.0 dBFS peak).

reference_material.quality_and_preprocessing_notes: All three files are finished video mixes with baked-in background music and SFX; 1000015040.mp4 and 1000015041.mp4 also contain brief secondary character lines. Vocal isolation and single-speaker trimming are required before provider reference upload. Forensic same-speaker identity across all three clips is unverified (1000015040.mp4 and 1000015041.mp4 sound closely consistent; 1000015039.mp4 has heavier compression).
